description: This file defines a generic internal class MemoryBatchContainer<TSerializer> that implements IBatchContainer and IOnDeserialized interfaces. It manages serialization and deserialization of message data, including payload handling, event retrieval, and request context import within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: MemoryBatchContainer<TSerializer>
classes.description: A generic internal class that encapsulates a batch of messages with serialization support, used within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: Payload
methods.description: Lazy loads and deserializes the payload from MessageData if not already deserialized.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the events from the payload, casting them to the specified type T and associating each with a sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context from the payload into the current context if available.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Callback invoked after deserialization to initialize the serializer using the service provider.
